# The DRIPBaR Cinco Ranch

> The DRIPBaR Cinco Ranch is an IV therapy and wellness lounge in Cinco Ranch, Katy, Texas, in the Stableside shopping center on Gaston Road. Services include IV vitamin drips, intramuscular quick shots, NAD+, High Dose Vitamin C, physician-guided GLP-1 medical weight management, medically supervised peptide therapy, red light therapy, and halotherapy, delivered by licensed medical professionals under physician oversight. Every first visit begins with a brief health screening.

Key facts:
- Address: 9920 Gaston Rd, Suite 170, Katy, TX 77494
- Phone: call or text (281) 720-8218
- Hours: Monday closed; Tuesday to Friday: 9 AM to 6 PM; Saturday: 10 AM to 5 PM; Sunday: 12 PM to 4 PM
- Booking: https://cincoranch.dripbar.app/booking (online request, confirmed by the team by text or call) or by phone
- Pricing: Lifestyle IV drips are $224 or $249 depending on the drip. The Debut is $224 and 100% Hydration is $119. NAD+ IV is $224 (125 mg), $249 (250 mg), or $499 (500 mg). High Dose Vitamin C is priced by dose from $169 after a consultation. Alpha Lipoic Acid IV is $179 to $329. IM Quick Shot blends are $50. Ask about member pricing.
- New guest offer: New guests choose their experience and receive up to $100 in free perks on the first visit: a Lifestyle drip, an add-on vitamin, and an additional service.
- Memberships: Essential, Evolve, Elevate, and Elite tiers with monthly quick shots or drips and flexible monthly credits. Call or text (281) 720-8218 for pricing.
- All services are administered under the supervision of Dr. A.D. Thakkar, M.D. Nothing on this site is medical advice; a consultation is required for GLP-1, peptide, High Dose Vitamin C, and NAD+ planning.
